snippet.title: Stravaeger Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Valtima IV is a retro rpg in the style of early Ultima games, incorporating survival and crafting gameplay from modern games such as Valheim.

You'll embark into a huge procedurally generated open world full of scenery to explore, enemies to fight, and resources to gather.  You'll find towns full of NPCs with valuable information to forward your quest.  You'll stumble across vast underground dungeons and cave systems full of danger and reward.

You'll craft better gear from the things you find in the world.  You'll build bases to keep safe from the perils of the world, store your belongings, cook food, and spend the night in the comfort of your warm bed.

Play it now at https://stravaeger.com
